text_blocks.snippet: No, Zelle cannot directly send or receive Bitcoin. Zelle is a payment network for sending and receiving money between bank accounts, while Bitcoin is a cryptocurrency that operates on a decentralized blockchain network. You can, however, use Zelle to fund your cryptocurrency exchange account, which then allows you to buy, sell, or send Bitcoin.

list.title: Zelle's Functionality:
list.snippet: Zelle facilitates instant bank transfers between users, typically within the same country and using their bank accounts.

list.title: Bitcoin's Nature:
list.snippet: Bitcoin is a digital currency that exists on a blockchain, a distributed ledger that records all transactions.

list.title: Bridging the Gap:
list.snippet: You can use Zelle to deposit funds into your account on a cryptocurrency exchange (like Coinbase or Kraken). Then, from that exchange, you can buy Bitcoin and send it to another wallet.

list.title: Buying Bitcoin with Zelle:
list.snippet: Several cryptocurrency exchanges and platforms allow you to buy Bitcoin using Zelle as a payment method.

list.title: Sending Bitcoin:
list.snippet: Once you have Bitcoin in your exchange account, you can send it to another Bitcoin address or wallet.

text_blocks.snippet: In essence, Zelle acts as a funding source for your cryptocurrency trading activities, but it's not a direct tool for Bitcoin transactions.
